verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's agent docs say every Model change (formulas, Table blocks, Page edits) goes into the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone, and the marketing docs add that every write is undoable. That covers who changed what plus per-change reversal. But no evidence shows the changelog records when each change happened, or that you can roll the model back to an earlier point in time, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: documented timestamps on changelog entries, point-in-time or bulk rollback beyond single-change undo, detail on what each changelog entry shows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every change to the model is logged with who changed what and when, and can be rolled back

citations.quote: Every change to the Model, such as a formula, a Table block, or a Page edit, is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone.
